sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:271

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:271:1
items.html: There is no distinction between this Mochin and that Mochin, except in the aspect of the form of the letter Hei of Elokim: For although the discernment of Yod-Hey was added here in the nursing, which is HB, nevertheless the Yod, which is the discernment of Hochma, has no revelation at all in the discernment of the names of Elokim, except in that it is clothed and hidden within the discernment of Bina, for the name Elokim is attributed to Bina and not to Hochma, as is known. And even within Bina herself, it is not revealed except from the Chazeh [chest] downward (as above, page 897, item 48), namely in her posterior. And therefore the distinction between these three Mochin, HBD, is not recognized except in the Hei of Elokim, which is the discernment of Bina.
